title: 不定代词

examples.en: There is something interesting in today's newspaper.
examples.zh: 今天的报纸上有件有趣的事。

guess.question: 为什么是 something interesting，而不是 interesting something？

options.text: 复合不定代词被形容词修饰时，形容词一律放在后面
options.feedback: 对！something / anything / nothing 的形容词永远后置，这是一条硬规则。

options.text: 因为 interesting 这个词比较长
options.feedback: 不对——长短无关，something new 也一样后置。
不对——只能后置，放前面就是错的。

rule.rule: some 系列多用于肯定句，any 系列多用于否定句和疑问句；形容词修饰复合不定代词时必须后置
rule.formula: ① 肯定句：something / someone　② 否定句、疑问句：anything / anyone　③ 形容词后置：something new / anything important　④ nothing = not…anything

anchors.en: I have something important to tell you.
anchors.zh: 我有件重要的事要告诉你。

anchors.en: Is there anyone in the room?

trap.wrong: I have interesting something to tell you.
trap.right: I have something interesting to tell you.
trap.why: 形容词修饰复合不定代词要后置。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——记住两条：形容词往后放；否定疑问用 any 系列。

options.distractor: 形容词不能放在复合不定代词前面

check.explanation: 肯定句 + 形容词后置：something new。

check.stem: — Is there ____ at home? — No, ____ is out.

options.distractor: 第二空要表达“大家”，用 everyone
答语说“都出去了”，用 everyone

check.explanation: 疑问句用 anyone；答语“都出去了”用 everyone。

options.text: I have something important to do.
I have important something to do.
I have important anything to do.
options.distractor: 肯定句用 something，且形容词要后置

options.text: I have anything important to do.
